images.prompt:
Create a NEW beautifully designed Chinese architecture infographic for CallBridge, replacing a rejected long dense text-heavy technical chart. Use case infographic-diagram. Asset 2 in an editorial set. Portrait aspect ratio around 4:5, high resolution, crisp readable text. Sophisticated warm off-white background, deep ink typography, muted teal for AUDIO and lavender for VIDEO, restrained apricot for controls. Elegant Apple-quality documentation illustration, large clear hierarchy, generous gutters and whitespace, precise thin arrows, fewer boxes, compact purposeful labels. This is a TOTAL DESIGN, NOT a progress report. No "implemented", "pending", "verified" or statuses. Not a screenshot, no device mockup frame.
Main title exact "CallBridge 总体技术方案".
Subtitle exact "Rust 核心 · macOS 原生适配 · 虚拟音视频设备".
Small but readable attribution exact "方案署名：GPT6 Astra".

Layout: a short control strip at top, two balanced parallel pipeline columns in the middle, converging to a shared call destination; a small shared-foundation band at bottom. Clear data flow top to bottom. Keep all text to the specified labels, no added paragraphs. Make connectors correct and legible.

TOP CONTROL STRIP: light apricot rounded container with left "AppKit 控制面板" and compact labels "文字 / 模式 / 角色 / 发送 / 停止"; a right arrow to "Rust 会话控制" with labels "权限意图 · generation · 取消". A thin control arrow forks downward to both pipeline headings.

LEFT COLUMN heading "声音链路". At top, three small illustrated source tabs: "文字 → 系统 TTS", "麦克风 → 现场环境", "本地文件 → 背景音". Under these a short mode label "A0 仅 TTS / A1 + 现场 / A2 + 素材". The three tabs feed a single box "格式统一 + 有界缓冲", small secondary labels "48 kHz · Float32" and "重采样 / 时钟漂移校正". Arrow down to a visually emphasized Rust core box "Rust 音频引擎", inside only "独立增益 · 背景压低 · 限幅" and "按实际播放位置取样". Arrow down to "输出专用 AUHAL" with small "显式绑定设备 · 输入关闭". Arrow down to "BlackHole / 虚拟麦克风" with small "软件回环，不经过扬声器". Audio color teal throughout. Distinguish this software-loopback from a real microphone.
RIGHT COLUMN heading "画面链路". At top two source tabs "授权摄像头" and "无摄像头 + TTS 动画". Arrow to "Vision + Rust" with secondary "姿态关键点 → RigState". Arrow to emphasized renderer box "Metal 画面合成", inside "Cartoon 替身 / 服装模板" and "角色包：素材 · 锚点 · 动作映射". A tiny original cute teal character and simple jacket icon beside this renderer can add restrained visual interest without crowding. Arrow to "IOSurface 帧交换", secondary "有界槽位 · generation · PTS". Arrow to "CMIO Camera Extension", secondary "虚拟摄像头 · 只发送最终画面". Video color muted lavender.
One fine dashed cross-link from Rust audio engine to Metal renderer, clearly label "实际播放包络 → 嘴部", not connected to the microphone. A separate subtle shared-time label near the lane bases "同一 host clock · 音视频时间戳".

DESTINATION: both lanes end at one broad clean box "FaceTime / 微信等通话软件", smaller "选择虚拟麦克风与摄像头", then a clear arrow to a simple headphone-person icon labeled "对方听见 / 看见".

BOTTOM FOUNDATION, three short columns separated by subtle rules, no paragraphs:
"实时边界" / "不等待锁 · 不分配 · 不做文件 IO"
"停止与隐私" / "旧代次失效 · 静音 / 隐私画面"
"素材扩展" / "声明式资源包 · 校验版本与授权"

Visual priority: main flows understandable from large labels; technical detail is brief subordinate labels. Avoid dozens of text-heavy cards, long wall-of-text paragraphs, tiny fonts, tangled arrows, crowded color fills, progress labels, decorative faux code. This should be much more concise and visually comfortable than a 5000px-tall documentation dump, but still communicate professional architecture. Exact Chinese spelling and typography matter.

Create a NEW Chinese illustrated explanatory infographic for CallBridge documentation, replacing a rejected dense text-heavy flowchart. Use case illustration-story / simple infographic. Landscape 3:2, high resolution. It should match a friendly polished animated-film editorial illustration set: warm ivory backdrop, muted sage green, sky blue, apricot, soft 2.5D shapes, subtle thin dark outlines, appealing original cartoon young adults and one cute little teal robot. Beautiful expansive composition, a light playful studio scene, not a dashboard and not a wall of rounded text cards. A simple analogy that someone with no computer knowledge understands instantly.

Large title exact "你的电话配音工作室".
Small eyebrow exact "03 / CALLBRIDGE".
Subheading exact "你负责打字，它负责开口。"

Main scene is ONE continuous left-to-right story, four equally clear stations occupying center:
1 A cartoon young adult quietly types at a laptop, mouth closed, with a small paper note emerging from the screen. Label "你写纸条". In a tiny speech-like paper bubble show exact "你好！" but depict this as written text, not spoken by the human.
2 The note travels via a single arrow to a cute friendly original teal robot voice actor wearing headphones, reading the note and emitting a visible tiny golden soundwave. Label "小助手配音". Small secondary label "文字 → 语音". Robot is clearly the one producing sound; the typing human is silent.
3 The waveform travels along a pretty short small bridge/cable over a soft blue gap, marked with precise label "BlackHole", underneath label "声音传送桥". Waveform moves across the bridge into a generic video-call app window with a simple phone icon. The bridge does NOT speak or generate the sound. This is an illustrative virtual route, not an actual physical cable installation.
4 On the right a separate smiling young adult wearing headphones looks toward their laptop, receiving the golden soundwave from the call app. Label "对方听见".
Use large light arrows along the route, obvious direction, no crossing connectors.

Below the main scene, include just two small charming optional studio props as a very modest side vignette, not competing with the main flow: a tiny music mixer with label "加一点背景音"; a small stage with a cute original cartoon animal avatar and label "换一个卡通形象". These are supporting visual examples, not extra numbered steps.
At bottom, a very short standalone sentence in medium type: "虚拟麦克风负责接声音，不负责念纸条。"
All exact text should be crisp Simplified Chinese with no typos. Keep total text under 85 Chinese characters except BlackHole. No detailed explanation, no Rust names, no generation/state diagrams, no warnings wall, no status categories, no paragraphs, no technical jargon beyond the one bottom sentence. Strong emphasis on illustration, personality, storytelling and whitespace; easy to read on GitHub without zoom. Original characters only, no brand mascots. Finished image, not a mockup.
